definitions.explanation: A cicada whose clear, falling "kana-kana" call is heard at dawn and dusk from midsummer into early autumn.

examples.japanese: ヒグラシ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}いている→鳴く：04388_naku⟧。
⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、ヒグラシ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: When evening comes, you can hear the evening cicadas.

examples.japanese: カナカナ⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧ヒグラシ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鳴|な}き{声|ごえ}→鳴き声：16846_nakigoe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{夏|なつ}の{終|お}わり→夏の終わり：26768_natsunoowari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: When I hear the kana-kana of the evening cicadas, I feel that summer is nearly over.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
The call of the ヒグラシ is linked with dusk, late summer and a gentle melancholy, and in haiku it is a season word for early autumn. Its sound is rendered カナカナ, and the insect is also called カナカナ.

WRITING:
In kanji {蜩|ひぐらし}, common in literature; in everyday writing katakana.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦セミ→セミ：09931_semi⟧: cicada in general; ヒグラシ is one kind
